newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower across the board.

text.p: All Tokyo corn futures closed lower on Thursday, with nearby months particularly weak, following a drop on the CBOT corn market overnight, traders said.
Prices ranged from 10 to 400 yen lower, with the benchmark May 1998 contract closing 20 yen down at 14,500 yen per tonne.
The day's estimated volume was 32,556 lots.
Light selling from individual investors capped the topside throughout the day, traders said. Weakness on the Tokyo soybean market accelerated selling orders, they said.
The spot July expires on June 13.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system stood at $2.70-3/4 per bushel at 0735 GMT, down from $2.71-1/4 at Wednesday's close.
Spot July CBOT soybean futures were trading at $8.26-3/4 a bushel at 0735 GMT, down from $8.30 at Wednesday's close.
